subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins install --agent` as a storage-only feature now, or require a complete scoped plugin lifecycle/runtime contract before merge?
rationale: The PR changes public CLI and persisted plugin lifecycle semantics, but the safe product/security boundary for scoped plugin enablement, discovery, uninstall, update, and upgrade behavior is not defined by code or maintainer discussion yet.

options.title: Require Complete Scoped Lifecycle
options.body: Keep the PR open and require normalized agent identity plus scoped install, uninstall, update, discovery, doctor, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Storage-Only Scope
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally accept that `--agent` only changes install paths and records while runtime activation remains global, but the PR must document and prove that risk clearly.

options.title: Pause Or Close This Shape
options.body: If storage-only agent installs are not a desired product state, pause or close this PR and keep the linked issue as the design discussion.

recommendation.title: Require Complete Scoped Lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require normalized agent identity plus scoped install, uninstall, update, discovery, doctor, and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows concentrated work on plugin install/uninstall hardening and lifecycle behavior on the touched files.
